vinyl-plank-flooring/lakewood-ranch.h1: Vinyl Plank Flooring in Lakewood Ranch, FL
vinyl-plank-flooring/lakewood-ranch.lede: Swapping bedroom carpet for SPC is the single most requested job across Lakewood Ranch's family villages, and it usually happens within a year or two of closing, not decades later.
vinyl-plank-flooring/lakewood-ranch.capsule: Solera, Mallory Park, Polo Run and Lakewood Ranch's other family-oriented villages replace builder-grade bedroom carpet with SPC luxury vinyl plank more than any other flooring product in the community. Most jobs are 800 to 1,200 sq ft of bedrooms and closets rather than a whole-house install. Typical 2026 installed ranges run $2.75 to $7.50 per sq ft depending on wear-layer thickness.
vinyl-plank-flooring/lakewood-ranch.body_html:
Walk through almost any closing package in Solera, Mallory Park or Polo Run and the bedrooms come with the same builder carpet, a mid-grade product chosen for cost rather than durability. Kids, dogs and Florida humidity wear through it faster than most new owners expect, and within a year or two of moving in a lot of these families call us about swapping it for SPC luxury vinyl plank instead. A 900 sq ft job covering two or three bedrooms and closets is a typical scope, small enough that we often finish in a single day once the furniture's been moved.

Second-floor bedrooms in these two-story villa and single-family plans need sound-rated underlayment even though the villages aren't true condos, since the floor above sits over a finished ceiling below. We spec a rated foam or cork underlayment on those jobs the same way we would in a shared-wall building, and check the HOA's flooring guidelines before ordering, since most design-review boards want a sample submitted first even for a bedroom-only job. Del Webb and Cresswind, the age-restricted 55-and-over sections within the larger community, run the same review process but skew toward whole-home installs rather than bedroom-only swaps, since those buyers are more often replacing every floor at once during a move-in renovation.

If you searched flooring installation near me from anywhere inside the Ranch, our office sits in the same 34212 ZIP, so most estimates happen within a day or two of the call. Our vinyl plank flooring page covers click-lock versus glue-down in more detail, and our post on whether to choose a 12 mil or 20 mil wear layer is a common question on these bedroom jobs. For the main living areas, where tile is still the builder default, see tile installation in Lakewood Ranch.
vinyl-plank-flooring/lakewood-ranch.cost_html: A 900 sq ft bedroom-and-closet swap in Solera or Mallory Park, moving from builder carpet to mid-range 20-mil SPC, runs $2.75 to $5.50 per sq ft, a typical 2026 installed range of $2,475 to $4,950. Carpet removal and haul-away adds $1.75 to $3.25 per sq ft, another $1,575 to $2,925 on the same footprint, for a combined total of roughly $4,050 to $7,875. A larger 1,600 sq ft whole-home Del Webb install in the same product tier scales to $4,400 to $8,800 before removal. These are typical 2026 ranges for Manatee and Sarasota counties, not quotes; the free in-home estimate confirms underlayment needs and HOA paperwork before pricing is final.

faqs.q: Do second-floor bedrooms in Lakewood Ranch need special underlayment?
faqs.a: Yes, we recommend a sound-rated foam or cork underlayment for any second-floor install, since the floor sits over a finished ceiling below even in single-family villa plans, not just in true condo buildings.

faqs.q: How fast do Solera and Mallory Park owners usually replace builder carpet?
faqs.a: Often within the first one to two years of closing. Kids, pets and daily humidity wear through the standard builder-grade carpet faster than most new owners expect, which is what drives most of these calls.

faqs.q: Do Del Webb and Cresswind installs go faster since they're single-family?
faqs.a: Not necessarily. These 55-and-over sections tend to book whole-home installs rather than bedroom-only swaps, so the job is often larger even though the underlying subfloor and HOA process are the same as the rest of Lakewood Ranch.
